verdict.rationale: An official BVNK repo named agent-wallet-cli (bvnk-probe-2) points to a first-party agent wallet tool. BVNK's API can also send stablecoins from an account (bvnk-docs-13, bvnk-docs-18). However, the pack never describes what the agent CLI does, and generic API payouts are only developer building blocks for an agent flow. Missing for 10: documented agent-initiated payment or payout flows, human-configured spend limits or scoped agent credentials, a description of the agent-wallet-cli's capabilities, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
